headline: Cleveland State's November run ends at Washington
dek: Cleveland State won at Robert Morris, at Milwaukee and at Purdue Fort Wayne in successive November matches, the last of them on the ground of the side atop the table. Washington ended the run, and Cleveland State's season stands at nine wins and seven defeats.
